title: Don't blame Dataset Shift! Shortcut Learning due to Gradients and Cross Entropy

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the CelebA dataset, where the gender of the celebrity acts as a spurious shortcut feature for the task of classifying hair color (blond or not).

Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset, where mentions of certain demographic identities act as spurious shortcuts for the task of classifying online comments as toxic or non-toxic.
Evaluating worst-group test accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset, where the image background (land or water) acts as a spurious shortcut for the task of classifying bird type (waterbird or landbird).
